activity_statements.statement: operates scheduled passenger air service to more than 140 cities across the Alaska Air Group ecosystem following the 2024 acquisition of Hawaiian Airlines
generated record revenues of $11.7 billion in 2024, with 48% from premium products, loyalty, ancillaries, and cargo
operates the Mileage Plan frequent-flyer loyalty program and sells miles to co-brand credit card and airline partners
flies widebody international routes from Seattle as a gateway to Tokyo, Seoul, and up to 12 long-haul destinations
operates a growing cargo business critical to Pacific Northwest and Hawaii communities
operates Horizon Air as a regional subsidiary providing feeder service into the mainline Alaska network
serves Hawaii inter-island travel through the Hawaiian Airlines brand and Huaka'i resident loyalty program

name_reality_gap: The 'Alaska Airlines' name implies a West Coast/Alaska regional carrier; post-2024 the company is a global airline including the Pacific, Hawaii inter-island, and international widebody routes — much broader than the name implies. The loyalty program and cargo revenue represent substantial non-ticket income invisible from the brand.
extraction_notes: Excellent sourcing from 2024 Annual Report shareholder letter. About page returned minimal content. Segment split estimated from annual report narrative; exact segment revenue ratios not extracted.
